verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent page says it will complete all the paperwork to switch registered agents, pay the state fees, and update the registered-agent record with your Secretary of State at no cost to you. That covers the core of the story: the new provider prepares and files the change. Missing for 10: any per-state documentation of change-of-agent form names and fee amounts, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the switch filing works as described.
